shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab
registers or horizontal bands dividing the surface
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery divided into stacked horizontal registers, with profile creatures (including bird-like heads) and rows of small repeated signs, which gives a loose arrangement correspondence. But A shows large isolated quadrupeds, a fox-like beast, a crouching figure and a fringed band with no writing, while B is dominated by dense columns of small script signs with seated/kneeling worshipping figures facing inward — the specific subjects, proportions and figure conventions are quite different.
